visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a top-down view of two purple and grey rectangular plates featuring perfectly sliced, medium-rare steak garnished with green broccoli florets. The lighting is bright and even, highlighting the pink interior of the meat and the charred grill marks on the crust. (2) The scene cuts to a white plastic package containing two thick, raw marbled steaks with a red and white Kirkland label. (3) Hands wearing transparent plastic gloves are seen seasoning a rectangular metal tray with salt and pepper from a grinder. One steak is placed on the tray, and more seasoning is applied. (4) The gloved hands pour a yellow liquid, likely oil, from a small white bowl onto the steak and rub it in thoroughly to coat the surface. (5) A pink and black square cast-iron grill pan is shown on an induction cooktop. A finger touches the digital controls to set the heat. Water droplets are flicked onto the pan, sizzling and evaporating instantly. (6) A single steak is placed on the pan using metal tongs, creating a visible puff of steam. A metal spatula is used to press the steak firmly against the grill ridges. The steak is flipped, revealing deep brown parallel grill marks. (7) The pan is rotated 90 degrees, and the steak is placed back to create cross-hatched grill marks. The edges and sides of the steak are also seared against the pan's surface. (8) The seared steak is moved to a white oval plate and placed inside a stainless steel oven. (9) The cooked steak rests on the plate outside the oven. (10) A hand uses a serrated bread knife to slice the rested steak on a yellow cutting board, revealing a consistent pink center. The final slices are arranged neatly on the purple serving plate seen in the beginning.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Logo]: @RosalinaKitchen. [Slogan]: 好市多的牛排怎麼煎 簡單又不易失敗的方法. [Subtitle]: 好市多的牛排該怎麼煎？分享一個零失敗的方法. (2) [Subtitle]: 這次我選擇的是 Prime 等級的紐約客. (3) [Variety]: 這種很厚的牛排 中間最容易不熟... [Subtitle]: 這種很厚的牛排 中間最容易不熟... (4) [Subtitle]: 這次來跟大家分享 很簡單的煎牛排方式！ (5) [Subtitle]: 先將牛排 (冷藏) 退冰 10 分鐘左右. (6) [Subtitle]: 用一個托盤 均勻撒上鹽跟胡椒. (7) [Subtitle]: 接著放上牛排. (8) [Subtitle]: 再均勻灑上鹽跟胡椒. (9) [Subtitle]: 用手抹勻. (10) [Subtitle]: 翻面再抹勻. (11) [Subtitle]: 在牛排上淋上耐高溫的油. (12) [Subtitle]: 均勻塗抹按摩一下. (13) [Subtitle]: 開中火加熱 * (感應爐開 7) 加熱約 3 分鐘. (14) [Subtitle]: 在鑄鐵 烙紋煎盤上灑水. (15) [Subtitle]: 水快速蒸發 表示溫度到了 (鍋子不需要放油). (16) [Subtitle]: 把牛排放上來 煎 1 分半左右. (17) [Subtitle]: 用鍋鏟壓一下 增加表面焦香. (18) [Subtitle]: 這樣紋路 會更明顯！ (19) [Subtitle]: 把牛排翻面放過來 再煎 1 分半左右. (20) [Subtitle]: 用鍋鏟壓一下 增加表面焦香. (21) [Subtitle]: 側面可以看到牛排的熟度. (22) [Subtitle]: 先把牛排放到盤子上. (23) [Subtitle]: 煎盤轉 90 度. (24) [Subtitle]: 牛排按照原來方向放回來. (25) [Subtitle]: 這樣就不會搞錯 牛排要怎麼放？才會格子紋. (26) [Subtitle]: 然後再翻面煎一分鐘. (27) [Subtitle]: 用鍋鏟壓一下 增加表面焦香. (28) [Subtitle]: 現在格紋都出來囉. (29) [Subtitle]: 喜歡紋路斜一點的話 牛排擺放再斜一點 或許格紋會更好看！ (30) [Subtitle]: 側面的部分也要煎一下. (31) [Subtitle]: 煎出表面焦香後 這樣牛排的鮮味 才會鎖住. (32) [Subtitle]: 上下也要. (33) [Subtitle]: 好囉！盛盤. (34) [Subtitle]: 這麼厚的牛排 目前還沒有熟喔！ (35) [Subtitle]: 放入已經預熱好 180 度的烤箱. (36) [Subtitle]: 接著烤箱關機！ (37) [Subtitle]: 在烤箱內 悶 7~10 分鐘. (38) [Subtitle]: 再將牛排取出來 靜置 12~15 分鐘. (39) [Subtitle]: 等牛排稍微冷卻再切 牛肉的鮮味 才不會流失喔. (40) [Subtitle]: 好囉！可以切牛排了. (41) [Subtitle]: 這一塊先切掉. (42) [Subtitle]: 我習慣用麵包刀切牛排 非常好切，哈. (43) [Subtitle]: 這樣先煎出焦香 再用烤箱悶的方式. (44) [Subtitle]: 可以讓牛排的熟度 更均勻喔！ (45) [Subtitle]: 有機會趕快動手試試看.

visual_human_presence.countingEvidence: 1 female creator visible by her hands only during the preparation process.
visual_human_presence.mainCharacterDescription: Adult female with fair skin, seen wearing transparent plastic disposable gloves during the raw meat handling stages.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: A clean, modern home kitchen featuring white walls, a black induction cooktop, and a wooden countertop. Stainless steel trays and plates are used throughout.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a female narrator's warm, professional voice explaining the objective of the video over a light, rhythmic acoustic guitar BGM. (2) A sharp grinding sound is heard as salt and pepper are applied to a metal tray. (3) A distinct metallic clink of tongs occurs as the meat is handled, followed by soft rustling sounds of plastic gloves rubbing the steak. (4) A gentle liquid pouring sound accompanies the addition of oil. (5) A high-pitched digital 'beep' triggers as the induction stove is activated. (6) A sharp hiss/sizzle sound erupts as water droplets hit the hot pan, followed by a much louder, sustained crackling sizzle when the steak is placed on the grill. (7) Percussive scraping sounds are heard as a metal spatula presses the meat against the pan. (8) A dull thud and plate clink occur as the steak is moved to the oval dish, followed by the mechanical sound of an oven door opening and closing. (9) Finally, the crisp, rhythmic sound of a knife cutting through a seared crust is heard as the narrator provides concluding instructions.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Linear: Hook -> Preparation -> Searing Technique -> Oven Finishing -> Resting -> Slicing -> Result
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a step-by-step instructional tutorial on how to perfectly cook a thick-cut steak from Costco (Kirkland brand) using a combination of pan-searing and oven-resting techniques to ensure an even medium-rare doneness and attractive grill marks.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The video explicitly highlights the Kirkland (Costco) steak packaging and uses Le Creuset cookware prominently.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video effectively utilizes close-up shots and high-quality audio sizzles to enhance the sensory appeal of the cooking process.
